_comment: Manual corrections applied by generate_calendar.py AFTER the parse. The parser reads the schedule row by row; a merged Clinical Skills practical cell leaves its middle hours blank, so the block gets split or cut short. Each date maps to a list of {clear, start, end, label, category, kind}. 'clear' is an HH:MM-HH:MM window: any parsed session whose start falls inside it is dropped, then the override session below is inserted. Anything labelled 'Clinical Skills- ...' renders in the grey ALA colour. Re-check these if the school reissues the schedule.
